notes.title: Update 7th December
notes.notes:
Meta progression update

Added meta progression (casual progression with stat upgrades).
You get diamonds while playing that can be spent to upgrade a wide range of different stats that are of use to all characters. Updates are one way and can't be refunded. 
Meta progression can be accessed from the main menu and affects all future runs.

Enjoy!

For future updates not much is planned and I would love to get some feedback/ideas!

notes.title: Update 2024-06-20
notes.notes:
Hi again ;)

It's time to shine some light on the recent changes to this project.
I have uploaded a new build which significantly changes the game in many ways!


     Reworked all units and added many more (unit count went from 6 to 21)
     Reworked all the characters to be more impactful and have meaningful stats
     Units now belong to classes and getting many of the same class will grant bonuses
     Units can now level up which grants them additional bonuses
     Reworked the amount of resources you get & prices
     Renamed Remnants to Perks and implemented a bunch of them
     Changed how items work, you can now have more items than 3 and they can be upgraded. 
     Most items now have unique properties that are somewhat like Perks
     Added a lot of upgrades that can be bought in the shop
     You can now upgrade items and perks in the shop
     Worked a lot on visual improvements and gfx
     Changes to UI to clarify what is what and make it more coherent


Stay tuned for more to come!

/Alfalou

notes.title: Update 2024-05-2
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

Features
Added ability to lock items in the shop, carries over until next time you are in the shop
The map is slightly bigger at default size
Started reworking units, reduced their upgrade count but made their upgrades more impactful
You can now shop any unit in the shop if you are not at max units, right now there is no immediate benefit except dps to have more units but I'm working on ways to make multi unit/weapon setups better/worthwhile/beneficial/FUN
Added some Upgrades with upsides and downsides (Mutated upgrades)

Bug fixes
Controller now working on Endgame screen
Fixed reroll costs being inflated
Tuned level up experience bar color
No longer possible to run outside the map

New Unit!
Volcano - damages enemies with a constant beam
